summary: The iOS app's Now opens with the person's own status, interruptions, deadline clock and directive note

schema.detail: No database, claim or client API change; the app uses the existing client-v0 availability operations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The app reads GET /v1/client/availability and GET /v1/client/notes whenever a connection goes live and on pull to refresh; it never polls.

compatibility.detail: A member whose capabilities do not list write.availability shows no availability section; an older app shows nothing new. A response word a later daemon adds reads as itself; a person no device has reported for a day reads as available.

recovery.detail: Nothing is stored on the phone; the next read shows the current state.
